decision_cruda.rationale: LH-02 is down at E569-07 (radio and CMMS agree). Likely repair is 13:20. LH-10 is idle at the workshop, so no home place loses production. Travel is 0.49 h. It loads 27.5 t/h at 10.5 g/t, which is about 0.9 oz/h. Este has trucks free (stockpile 51/450 t). By 13:20 it moves about 96 t (about 32 oz) and could clear all 168 t (about 57 oz) by 17:00 if the repair runs long. Reserves can't be activated because no stope has stopped. Taking a loader from a producing stope or a heading would cost more than it gains.

Keep LH-10 at E569-07 (151t, 10.5 g/t, LH-02 down to ~13:20). Lend LH-08 from the cheap preparation heading (1.3 oz/h) to C564-03 (220t, 9.6 g/t, LH-03 down to ~16:00), 0.32 h away. About 6 h of loading at 30 t/h gives ~180t, or ~55 oz, against ~8 oz of development lost. Central stockpile has room. LH-09 is critical path (4.2 oz/h) so it stays. Reserves can't be activated because no stope was stopped.
